blocks.text: Stoichiometry Greek alfaz stoicheion, unsur, aur metron, paimaish, se hai: reactants aur products ki miqdari (quantitative) paimaish. Yeh chemistry ki woh shakh hai jis mein mutawazan (balanced) kimiyai muadle mein reactants aur products ki miqdaron ka taalluq parha jata hai. Balanced muadle ke dono taraf har qism ke atoms ki tadaad barabar hoti hai aur reactants aur products ke muqarrar tanasub (ratios), jaise compounds mein anasir ke muqarrar tanasub hote hain, aur in tanasub se doosre maddon ka mass ya moles nikale jate hain. Stoichiometric hisabat mass ki baqa (conservation of mass) ke qanoon par chalte hain, jo kehta hai ke maddah (mass) na banaya ja sakta hai na mitaya, to balanced muadle mein reactants ka kul mass products ke kul mass ke barabar hai, aur muqarrar tanasub (definite proportions) ke qanoon par, jis ke mutabiq khalis compound mein hamesha wahi anasir mass ke usi tanasub mein mile hote hain.

blocks.title: Mole
blocks.text: Mole kisi madde ki woh miqdar hai jis mein utne bunyadi ajza (elementary entities) hon jitne carbon-12 ke 0.012 kg (12 g) mein atoms hain. Yeh ajza atoms, molecules, ions, electrons ya doosre zarraat ho sakte hain. Ise n se zahir karte hain.

Kisi madde ke ek mole mein ajza ki tadaad ek mustaqil adad hai jise Avogadro's number kehte hain, 6.02 x 10^23, jo NA se zahir hota hai aur Italian scientist Amedeo Avogadro (1776-1856) se mansoob hai. Is ki theek qeemat 6.02214179 x 10^23 fi mol hai; hisabat mein gol ki hui qeemat 6.02 x 10^23 istemal hoti hai. Carbon-12 ke ek mole mein 6.02 x 10^23 atoms, H2O ke ek mole mein 6.02 x 10^23 molecules, NaCl ke ek mole mein 6.02 x 10^23 formula units, aur Na+ ke ek mole mein 6.02 x 10^23 ions hain. Chemists mole ko atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions tolne aur ginne ke liye SI unit ke taur par istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Molar mass
blocks.text: Kisi madde (unsur, compound ya ionic species) ke ek mole ka mass, jo grams mein us ke atomic, molecular, formula ya ionic mass ke barabar hai, us ka molar mass M hai, g/mol mein. Yeh ajza atoms ke masses ka majmooa hai.

CCl4 ka molar mass ek carbon aur chaar chlorines ka molar mass hai: 12.0 x 1 + 35.5 x 4 = 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0 g. Carbon atoms ka ek mole 12.0 g, CO2 molecules ka ek mole 44.0 g, CaO formula units ka ek mole 56.1 g aur carbonate ions ka ek mole 60.0 g hai. Moles ki tadaad diya hua mass taqseem molar mass hai: n = m / M.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Sample Problem 4.2 ka jawab '18.3 mol' likha hai. Sawal mass ka hai, is liye unit gram hai: 0.5 x 36.5 = 18.25 g (taqreeban 18.3 g), 'mol' nahi.

items: Stoichiometry (stoicheion, metron) balanced muadle se reactants aur products napti hai, mass ki baqa aur muqarrar tanasub ke qanoon par chalte hue.
Mole mein utne ajza hain jitne 12 g carbon-12 mein atoms: Avogadro's number, 6.02 x 10^23 (NA). Molar mass M (g/mol) grams mein atomic, molecular, formula ya ionic mass hai (CCl4 154.0); n = m / M.
